cases.title: Lorazepam from a walk-in clinic plus low-dose quetiapine, both for sleep

expectations.label: mustInclude beers_avoid [lorazepam]
expectations.detail: beers_avoid "Ativan 0.5mg: benzodiazepine" (rule pim-benzodiazepine) on Ativan 0.5mg [lorazepam]
expectations.why: Lorazepam is a benzodiazepine; Beers lists benzodiazepines as medicines older adults should generally avoid (memory problems, delirium, falls, fractures).
expectations.source: AGS Beers 2023, Table 2 - Benzodiazepines (alprazolam, clonazepam, lorazepam, temazepam ...): Avoid (moderate quality; strong)

expectations.label: mustInclude beers_avoid [quetiapine]
expectations.detail: beers_avoid "Seroquel 25 mg: antipsychotic medicine" (rule pim-antipsychotic) on Seroquel 25 mg [quetiapine]
expectations.why: Quetiapine is an antipsychotic used here for sleep, which is not an FDA-approved indication; Beers lists antipsychotics as 'avoid' outside those indications.
expectations.source: AGS Beers 2023, Table 2 - Antipsychotics, first and second generation (quetiapine, risperidone ...): Avoid except FDA-approved indications (moderate; strong)

expectations.label: mustInclude fall_risk [lorazepam, quetiapine]
expectations.detail: fall_risk "Medicines linked to falls (2)" (rule fall-risk) on Ativan 0.5mg + Seroquel 25 mg [lorazepam, quetiapine]
expectations.why: Benzodiazepines and antipsychotics are named fall-risk-increasing drug classes.
expectations.source: CDC STEADI 'Medications Linked to Falls' fact sheet (2017): anticonvulsants, antidepressants (TCAs, SSRIs), antipsychotics, benzodiazepines, opioids, sedative-hypnotics (eszopiclone, zaleplon, zolpidem); also anticholinergics, antihistamines, medications affecting blood pressure, muscle relaxants

expectations.label: mustNotInclude cns_active_combo [any]
expectations.detail: none present
expectations.why: Only two CNS-active drugs (one benzodiazepine, one antipsychotic); the Beers combination criterion needs three or more.
expectations.source: AGS Beers 2023, Table 5 - Any combination of >=3 CNS-active drugs among antiepileptics (incl. gabapentinoids), antidepressants (TCAs, SSRIs, SNRIs), antipsychotics, benzodiazepines, Z-drugs, opioids, skeletal muscle relaxants: Avoid (high; strong)

expectations.label: ACB total = 3
expectations.detail: actual 3 (contributors: quetiapine 3)
expectations.why: Quetiapine 3 + lorazepam 0 (lorazepam is not on the ACB card) = 3.
expectations.source: ACB scale 2012 update (Aging Brain Care, Regenstrief Institute / Indiana University); scores are added per medication; Kinwise SPEC 6.2 raises a finding when the total is >=3

expectations.label: fallRiskMedIds include [lorazepam, quetiapine]
expectations.detail: actual: Ativan 0.5mg, Seroquel 25 mg
expectations.why: Benzodiazepine and antipsychotic.
expectations.source: STOPPFall (Seppala 2021, Age Ageing 50:1189, PMC8244563): 14 consensus FRID classes incl. benzodiazepines and related drugs, antipsychotics, opioids, antidepressants, antiepileptics, diuretics, alpha-blockers (antihypertensive and BPH), centrally acting antihypertensives, sedative antihistamines, vasodilators used in cardiac diseases, overactive-bladder/incontinence medications

findings.title: Seroquel 25 mg: can lower sodium levels
